ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels, estimated at 1:7 across the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark field with a dense distribution of small (1-5 pixel radius) high-intensity white punctate clusters across both lobes; no large contiguous blobs are present, but clusters show higher density toward the distal margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 110 degrees; the lower vertex depth is partially obscured by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 4 to 12 pixels, creating a jagged boundary across the entire trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit an upward-curving trajectory with a concave lower margin and a jagged, generally convex trailing edge sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Globally distributed high-contrast circular pixel clusters (rosettes) across both lobes, with significant clustering on the distal third of each lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly irregular, thickened pixel masses at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, indicating significant localized tissue accretion or permanent trauma.
